description: This file defines the CobaltTextToSpeechHelper class, which implements text-to-speech and accessibility state change handling for audio accessibility features in the Cobalt project. It manages a singleton TTS engine, handles speech requests, and monitors accessibility settings.

classes.name: CobaltTextToSpeechHelper
classes.description: Helper class implementing text-to-speech and accessibility state change handling for audio accessibility in Cobalt.

methods.name: CobaltTextToSpeechHelper
methods.description: Constructor initializing the helper, setting up accessibility listeners, and starting a background thread.

methods.name: shutdown
methods.description: Shuts down the TTS engine, stops the background thread, and removes accessibility listeners.

methods.name: isScreenReaderEnabled
methods.description: Checks if a screen reader is currently enabled.

methods.name: onInit
methods.description: Callback for TTS engine initialization; processes pending utterances or marks failure.

methods.name: speak
methods.description: Enqueues or speaks text via TTS engine, creating the engine if necessary.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Stops ongoing speech and clears pending utterances.

methods.name: onAccessibilityStateChanged
methods.description: Handles changes in overall accessibility state.

methods.name: onTouchExplorationStateChanged
methods.description: Handles changes in touch exploration (talkback) state.

methods.name: finishIfScreenReaderChanged
methods.description: Detects changes in screen reader status and triggers a native event if changed.

methods.name: nativeSendTTSChangedEvent
methods.description: Native method to notify about TTS or accessibility state changes.
